title: Label Unification for Cross-Dataset Generalization in Cybersecurity NER
abstract: arXiv:2507.13870v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The field of cybersecurity NER lacks standard-ized labels, making it challenging to combine datasets. We investigate label unification across four cybersecurity datasets to increase data resource usability. We perform a coarse-grained label unification and conduct pairwise cross-dataset evaluations using RoBERTa models. Qualitative analysis of predictions reveals errors, limitations, and dataset differences. To address unification limitations, we propose alternative architectures including a multi-head model and a graph-based transfer model. Under our selected mapping and training setup, unified training underperformed the corresponding single-dataset baselines on all four development sets. The multi-head model with weight sharing provides no consistent benefits over single-dataset baselines, and the graph-based transfer model shows no consistent benefits.

translated_title: 网络安全命名实体识别中面向跨数据集泛化的标签统一
translated_abstract: 网络安全命名实体识别（NER）领域缺乏标准化的标签，这使得数据集难以合并使用。我们研究了四个网络安全数据集之间的标签统一，以提高数据资源的可用性。我们进行了粗粒度的标签统一，并使用RoBERTa模型开展两两跨数据集评估。对预测结果的定性分析揭示了错误、局限性以及数据集之间的差异。为解决标签统一的局限性，我们提出了替代架构，包括多头模型和基于图的迁移模型。在我们选定的映射和训练设置下，统一训练在全部四个开发集上的表现均低于相应的单数据集基线。具有权重共享的多头模型相比单数据集基线没有带来一致的收益，基于图的迁移模型也未显示出一致的收益。
tldr: 该论文研究了四个网络安全NER数据集的标签统一以提升数据可用性，但实验表明统一训练、多头模型和图迁移模型均未能稳定超越单数据集基线。
en_tdlr: This paper investigates label unification across four cybersecurity NER datasets, finding that unified training, multi-head models, and graph-based transfer models do not consistently outperform single-dataset baselines.
